item.title: #LC746 - Minimum Cost Of Climbing Stairs
item.description:
In this post we will look into the the leetcode #746 problem to find the minimum cost of climbing stairs. This is also a good example to start your journey to learn dynamic programming.

Problem Statement

You are given an integer array cost where cost[i] is the cost of ith step on a staircase. Once you pay the cost, you can either climb one or two steps. You can either start from the step with index 0, or the step with index 1.
